existing.description: The ANU University Research Scholarship supports high-achieving higher degree by research (HDR) students whose research aligns with the strategic directions of the Australian National University. It is awarded through ANU's two annual central scholarship rounds alongside the Research Training Program and other centrally managed scholarships, and no separate application is required: prospective candidates are considered automatically on the basis of their admission application. The value is a fortnightly stipend of $40,475 per annum (2027 full-time base rate), paid for 3.5 years for PhD candidates or 1.5 years for MPhil candidates. Each ANU College convenes a selection committee to score and rank all eligible H1 (or equivalent) applicants on academic record, research potential, supervisor support, referee reports and English language competency.
eligibility: Be a domestic student or an international student enrolled in an accredited HDR course of study at ANU
Have achieved a minimum of Honours (H1) or H1 equivalent in their prior studies
Not be an Industry PhD Candidate receiving a full-time salary
existing.eligibility_summary: Available each year to a prospective or continuing student who is a domestic or international student enrolled in an accredited HDR course of study at ANU, has achieved a minimum of Honours (H1) or H1 equivalent in their prior studies, and is not an Industry PhD Candidate receiving a full-time salary. Selection requires each ANU College to convene a selection committee to score and rank all eligible H1 (or equivalent) applicants in a merit-based process.
benefits: Fortnightly stipend at $40,475 per annum (full-time base stipend rate 2027)
Travel and removal allowances for students relocating to Canberra to commence their research program
Dependant Child allowance for international students only
Paid medical, maternity and parental leave
coverage: Fortnightly stipend of $40,475 per annum (2027 full-time base stipend rate)
Travel and removal allowances for students relocating to Canberra
Paid medical, maternity and parental leave
requirements: Apply for admission by the relevant round deadline (31 August international, 31 October domestic for Round 1)
Applications must be complete, including all supporting documentation and referee reports, by the scholarship deadline
It is strongly recommended to submit the application 2-3 weeks before the deadline to allow referees time to submit reports
Maintain the academic performance required for continuation of the award
documents: Complete HDR admission application to ANU, with the 'Australia: ANU - Other Scholarship' option selected for consideration for all eligible scholarships
All supporting documentation and referee reports by the scholarship deadline
Referee reports obtained via the ANU referee request process
existing.english_requirement: English language competency forms part of the merit-based ranking used by the ANU College selection committees.
application_method: Apply for admission to an HDR program at ANU
Select 'Australia: ANU - Other Scholarship' in the admission application to be considered for all eligible scholarships
Nominate referees, whose reports are requested automatically at the time of application submission
Current candidates (typically less than 1 year full-time equivalent completed) must submit the 'Request for a current ANU student to be considered for a HDR scholarship' form
existing.selection_notes: Each ANU College convenes a selection committee to score and rank all eligible H1 (or equivalent) applicants in a merit-based process. Overall ranking considers academic record, research potential (including support from the prospective supervisor and the location in which research will be undertaken), referee reports, English language competency, and comparison with other applications received in the same scholarship round. Continuation is based on academic performance and a 6 month extension is available.
existing.duration: Payments made for 3.5 years (PhD candidates) or 1.5 years (MPhil candidates)
existing.application_period: ANU states the application period is open all year round, with consideration organised into two annual central rounds. Round 1 international applications close 31 August and domestic applications 31 October for commencement by the end of March the following year; Round 2 is for commencement by the end of August the same year.
existing.deadline_display: Round 1 (commencement by end of March the following year): International application deadline 31 August; Domestic application deadline 31 October. Round 2: commencement by end of August the same year. No separate application is required.
existing.program_type: Academic merit - centrally managed scholarship round

scholarships.title: University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS)

existing.description: The University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS) is a competitively awarded stipend scholarship for international students commencing or already enrolled in a higher degree by research at the University of Sydney. It pays a stipend of $44,293 per annum at the 2027 rate, indexed annually, plus relocation and thesis allowances. Holders are automatically awarded the companion University of Sydney Tuition Fee Scholarship, which covers 100% of tuition fees for up to 14 research periods together with Overseas Student Health Cover, making the combined package a full funding package for international research students. Preference may be given to applicants intending to enrol in, or already enrolled in, a PhD, and to applicants who have not previously completed an HDR course or held an equivalent scholarship at the same level.
eligibility: Be commencing or enrolled in a higher degree by research at the University of Sydney
Preference: intending to enrol or currently enrolled in a PhD
Preference: have not previously received an Australian Government or University Scholarship to complete an HDR course at the same level
Preference: have not previously completed an HDR course at the same level of study
existing.eligibility_summary: For international students who are commencing or already enrolled in a higher degree by research at the University of Sydney and are competitively awarded the scholarship. Preference may be given to applicants intending to enrol or currently enrolled in a PhD, applicants who have not previously received an Australian Government or University Scholarship to complete an HDR course at the same level, and applicants who have not previously completed an HDR course at the same level of study.

existing.application_period: Two international rounds per year. For Research Period 1 and 2, 2027 the submission deadline was 11 September 2026; the next still-applicable deadline on the University timeline is 18 December 2026 for Research Period 3 and 4, 2027, with outcomes issued from 26 February 2027 and finalised 18 May 2027 for off-shore applicants and 30 June 2027 for applicants completing a degree in Australia.
existing.deadline_display: Submission deadlines for the international RTP/USYDIS rounds are published in the University application and award timeline: 11 September 2026 for Research Period 1 and 2, 2027 (outcomes issued from 10 November 2026, finalised 17 December 2026); 18 December 2026 for Research Period 3 and 4, 2027; and 10 September 2027 for Research Period 1 and 2, 2028. All required admission documentation must be submitted through Sydney Courses and the scholarship application form submitted by the deadline.
existing.program_type: Higher degree by research scholarship, competitively awarded
